feature: 借扇成蝶 · 侧翼排练

sources.title: 越剧诞生120周年纪念暨浙江大学学生越剧社2026年度大戏《梁祝》
sources.use: 确定本校越剧社、梁祝题材和演出场地的关联。公告不是舞台技术方案，未据此虚构该场扇子、灯或布景配置。

sources.title: 天上掉下个周妹妹
verifiedFacts: 本校学生越剧社排演过全本《梁祝》与《陆游与唐琬》。
2019年11月在中国教育电视台《戏聚校园》演绎《梁祝·十八相送》。
报道叙述社员反复揣摩唱腔、咬字、身段及排练。
sources.use: 侧翼排练的校园生活依据；不复写唱词或人物身份。

sources.title: 浙江小百花越剧团入驻浙音合演新版《梁祝》，开启院团合作新征程
verifiedFacts: 报道2017年6月20日的小百花与浙音合作首演。
文章明确说明结尾用扇子的表演表达化蝶意象。
sources.use: 将真实戏曲道具语义转译为可操作的扇影组合；不声称本项目复原这台演出。

sources.title: 《前线》| 高校原创文化精品：中央戏剧学院原创话剧《梁祝》
verifiedFacts: 文章列出草亭结拜、同窗三载、十八相送、再相会、化蝶等核心情境。
创作以民族表达方式融合现代舞台手段。
sources.use: 采用可识别的主题意象和小步引入规则的方法；不是浙大2026场的场次表。

sources.title: 梁祝的一年 2024–2025
verifiedFacts: 制作方用十八相送中的比喻、同窗与走过的时间讨论表达与理解。
sources.use: 把操作前后的可见变化留给玩家理解，避免默认文字直接给出参数。该来源是另一部现代舞台作品，不并入浙大演出的事实记录。

storyContinuity.existingProduction: 保留虚构学生剧《7:55》的原CC98售票档案；实际2026年6月越剧公告是设计参考。
preserved: 三张节目单与spotlight/opening/finale原节目顺序
票扫码取得荧光粉刷、风口撒粉
原三幕追光小游戏及完整验证
剧院出口至campus_qizhen_loop，再交给现有三来源手机调查

newEntry.requires: 已验票、原剧院场景、浅色操作、真实距离

storyContinuity.completion: 只完成本次可重玩排练，不写主线、道具、钱包、存档或检查点。

progressionDesign.newRule: 横向移扇改变同一纱幕上的影子位置
progressionDesign.presentation: 一把扇架、一盏灯、一片可见轮廓。第一幕扇架纵深固定。
progressionDesign.discovery: 拖动实体底座，影子同步变化；不显示参数或操作顺序。

progressionDesign.newRule: 灯、扇、幕之间的前后距离改变投影尺寸
progressionDesign.presentation: 沿用同一物体与幕，增加纵深移动；先前横向移动仍可用。
progressionDesign.discovery: 影子大小随实际投影比变化，试演指出尺寸差异，位置保留。

progressionDesign.newRule: 双物体投影组合，另一件实体侧幕也会遮光
progressionDesign.presentation: 不同尺寸的两把扇架，加一片可移动宽侧幕；两扇在不同实际纵深对合成蝶影。
progressionDesign.discovery: 宽影与侧幕同步移动；错误试演保留位置，可继续当前幕。

implementation.projection: screenX = x * screenDepth / propDepth；screenRadius = propRadius * screenDepth / propDepth
implementation.input: 鼠标或触摸拖动实际物体；Tab选物、WASD/方向键、Enter试演、Z撤回、R重排、Esc暂停。键盘说明只在主动打开的观察面板呈现。
implementation.failure: 当前幕原位继续；撤回以完整拖动手势为单位；重排保留已完成幕。
implementation.hints: 玩家主动打开观察；三层逐步从现象到结构到相关物件，不给坐标答案。
implementation.sessionValidation: nonce、原state对象身份、原scene/phase/mode/checkpoint、真实距离、完整合法动作trace、layoutDigest；取消/替换/离开不恢复旧session。

generatedAssets.contract: 固定逻辑舞台960×540；全景均匀缩放、实体透明cutout独立载入、投影/轮廓/物理地面不烘焙主线角色或答案。世界扇架使用与footprint一致的独立架体图；内部大小不同的扇仍使用同一source art均匀缩放。

pending: Physical Android/iOS device orientation, performance and hardware gesture acceptance

fixture.preparation: 原c3-theater-program开发验收快照，显式摆到原生可站立的source坐标560206，通过普通save validator与export_save导出；未声称玩家从售票流程挣得该快照。

historicalFailures.finding: 首帧Label的自动换行最小尺寸把intro撑到3105px，实际开始按钮越出屏幕。
historicalFailures.fix: 阅读正文改为fit_content=false的可滚动RichTextLabel，保留真实按钮边界和点击验收。

historicalFailures.finding: 390×844时intro面板从y92开始，遮住顶部Exit中心。
historicalFailures.fix: 竖屏面板从y124开始，真实Exit重玩/返回和intro不覆盖Exit断言通过。

historicalFailures.finding: The only failing assertion sampled the real console base while checking its adjacent open gap.
historicalFailures.fix: Moved the sample to real clear floor at1220535; retained the real desk collider.

historicalFailures.finding: A right-seat cleaning donor crossed the original console and repeated desk legs. Tiny baked door diagonals also survived.
historicalFailures.fix: Moved cleaning donors to clear right-aisle source carpet; cleaned complete source leaf rectangles while preserving door posts and architecture.

historicalFailures.finding: The first touch switched the reading-sheet layout underneath the held Start button; a replay could keep its introduction open.
historicalFailures.fix: Touch capability is remembered immediately, but sheet-layout switching waits for its explicit close. Final real-touch intro/replay and Main tests pass.

acceptance.shortKeyboardInput: Keydown applies an immediate step; held repetition waits 0.075 seconds. Keydown/up inside the same rendered frame still preserves one step.

objectRebuild.selectedFamily: three generated objects with exact source-atlas fallback for the entire family
objectRebuild.geometry: Six seat groups use independent row polygons. The original sound-operator chair is separate. Generated chest, console and narrow cabinet are uniformly fitted to actual alpha bounds at authored ground baselines. Baked exit door leaves are cleaned; InteriorDoorLayer alone draws moving leaves.
objectRebuild.cache: Successful geometry and clean meshes survive scene reentry. Missing images retry at 250ms. Successful frames never reread texture.get_image or rescan alpha.
objectRebuild.visualReview: Temporary browser canvas composited the same source-pixel manifest; clean background and generated object assembly were inspected. This is not Godot Web release acceptance. Temporary images were removed after inspection.
objectRebuild.knownPresentationObservation: Local same-source floor/carpet repetition can show texture seams when every fixture is hidden; no playability issue was found in normal composed presentation.

mobileSceneInput.status: Native accepted; actual Godot Web browser matrix accepted with explicitly recorded Firefox phone prefs and physical-device gap
mobileSceneInput.reason: Actual Godot Web390x844 visual review showed about350px empty below the previous button row. User then requested Touchable-style contextual input and landscape game scenes.
mobileSceneInput.implementation: Touch landscape maximizes the original960x540 stage at a uniform scale with a24px title strip. No permanent operation buttons remain. A portrait fallback requests rotation and keeps observation/exit available. Desktop buttons and keyboard remain.

gestures.drag: Tap/select and directly drag the same real prop through existing _move_prop. A gesture crossing10px stays a drag.
gestures.lamp: Tap the visible stage lamp to try, continue a completed scene or finish the full rehearsal. A later physical mouse can use the same lamp on hybrid devices.
gestures.observe: Hold a real prop0.6seconds without crossing10px to request the existing layered hint sheet.
gestures.undo: Two-finger tap restores one whole previous drag.
gestures.menu: Two-finger hold0.6seconds opens a temporary opaque paper sheet with Return/Undo/Restart/Pause/Exit. Closing explicitly resumes.
gestures.ownership: Second finger retires the prior single-finger drag; consumed/third-finger gestures do not restart an action. Cancel, resize, focus loss and paper overlays clear stale owners.

mobileSceneInput.discoverability: First introduction explains gestures and menu access without projection equations, target coordinates or the solution.
nativeChecks: three stages via physical touch drags and the real lamp
two-finger whole-drag undo and held paper menu
held prop requests one hint layer
paper overlay blocks physical drag below it
real menu Pause/Return and replay Exit
active touch cancellation, Main resize and Window.focus_exited
original controller completion and identical game-state/primary-save/backup bytes
